description: This PHP class, FencedCodeRenderer, handles rendering of fenced code blocks in Markdown for Confluence content, supporting various programming languages, special cases like 'tex' and 'mermaid', and integrates with project-specific configuration.

classes.name: FencedCodeRenderer
classes.description: Handles rendering of fenced code blocks in Markdown for Confluence, supporting language highlighting, special rendering for 'tex' and 'mermaid', and configuration integration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with project-specific configuration.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a code block node as an HTML element, with special handling for 'tex' and 'mermaid' languages.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Determines the language of the code block, applying known conversions.
